text:
Maya (CS): quick capture from OrchidMed kickoff. Main feedback & risk signals: 1) want route-level cost caps (they run large-batch embeddings for clinical notes), 2) onboarding checklist gapsthey hit a blocker on KMS integration, 3) need clearer retry/error tracing in Console for SREs, 4) asked for a short checklist for embedding chunking best-practices for clinical text. Marking renewal at-risk if we don't show progress.

Diego - PM: thanks. can we get concrete repro data for the embeddings issue? Also want to understand how often KMS errors happen during their setup.

Maya (CS): attached anonymized payloads to CS-5566 and included a snippet they pasted: ```{"note_id":"nm-002","text":"Patient summary... ~9k chars with scanned PDF OCR noise"}``` They said recall drops after ~6k tokens.

Rin (Support): logged related ticket INC-3012 from another account. Frequency: 5 tickets in last month labeled "embedding-low-recall". Adding OrchidMed samples now.

Ishaan (Eng): for recall drop: first suspicion is chunking + OCR noise. We can try doc-cleaning heuristics + different chunk sizes. Will spin up a repro job if we have samples.

Ava (Docs): I can draft a 1-page clinical embeddings checklist: recommended chunking, overlap, OCR cleanup tips, and an example pipeline. Low effort.

Maya (CS): csbot: created signal CS-5566. Priority: high-risk. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/CS-5566

csbot: New customer signal recorded: CS-5566 (OrchidMed) labeled: at-risk.

Diego - PM: prioritization proposal: 1) route-level cost caps (pilot; high commercial impact), 2) retry/traces in Console (SRE/UX), 3) embeddings checklist + engineering spike, 4) onboarding KMS runbook. Agree?

Ishaan (Eng): agree. I can own the embeddings spike (2 weeks) and post findings. If quick wins, we can publish interim guidance.

Maya (CS): I can coordinate KMS onboarding with Support + Security; will create a small runbook and share with customer.

Rin (Support): will add severity tags: OrchidMed -> revenue-risk; INC-3012 -> ux-annoyance. Also will attach logs for KMS failures.

Diego - PM: action items: Ishaan -> embed spike (owner). Ava -> docs checklist. Maya -> runbook + customer comms. Rin -> attach logs + add severity tags. I'll slot a 30-min groom tomorrow to scope route-cost-cap UI + backend effort.

Maya (CS): draft customer note: "thanks team. we're opening a short pilot to add route-level caps & follow-up with an embeddings checklist and KMS runbook. We'll confirm timelines after the engineering spike."

csbot: Label update: CS-5566 tagged [revenue-risk, onboarding-blocker].

Ishaan (Eng): posting initial plan in CS-5566 when I start. If chunking is root cause, interim recommendation: chunk size 1k2k tokens with 20% overlap, plus simple OCR cleaning to remove headers/footers.

Ava (Docs): I'll have a draft checklist by EOD tomorrow and will add an appendix with the recommended chunk sizes.

Diego - PM: thanks. One ask: can Support surface "repeat offender" metric (how many customers hit embedding/docs issues) to help prioritize?

Rin (Support): yes, I'll add a quick query and post numbers in the groom.

Maya (CS): thanks team. Scheduling 20-min groom tomorrow 11am PT. If anyone needs to push, ping me.

Diego - PM: solid. Keeping this moving is important for renewal. :+1:
